hannah: Deploybot rejected publish for ecr://redwood/ingest:canary-2026-08-04 — hold.

deploybot: [automated] publish-hold: attestation subject mismatch detected across replicated registries. summary:
registry-us-east: subject = projects/redwood/builds/b-778
registry-eu-west:  subject = projects/redwood/builds/b-779
registry response: 400 AttestationSubjectMismatch - replica subjects must match for manifest list.

oliver: we retried the EU push from a rebuild; looks like the retry produced a new buildid and the attestation referenced the new one while US still points to the original.

meera: confirm — logs show initial push created manifest list then EU retry pushed a new arm64 entry with buildid b-779. the cosign step for the retry signed that entry.

hannah: options: 1) pin to previous known-good digest and postpone canary; 2) revert EU replica to the original object (not supported by registry); 3) rebuild both arches on same CI run to ensure identical buildid and re-publish. which is least risky?

oliver: least risky is pin -> previous digest for immediate serving, then schedule a coordinated rebuild+publish in the change window. avoid any in-place registry edits. :no_entry: 

meera: agree. previous known-good digest: sha256:ec1a3f9b4f2d9e8a0cd1234a5678b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f567. we'll pin traffic and document fallback.

deploybot: noted. recommended action: pin -> ecr://redwood/ingest@sha256:ec1a3f9b4f2d9e8a0cd1234a5678b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f567; schedule rebuilt cross-arch publish in 02:30 UTC change window; update release notes and support PSA.

hannah: release-coordinator — can you approve 02:30 UTC? need to communicate fallback to SRE/sales.

release-coordinator: 02:30 UTC approved. I'll add a public note: "Canary deferred — attestation subject mismatch across replicas; serving pinned to prior digest." I'll also ping #support and the EU mirror ops.

oliver: infra action: add a CI gate so any cross-arch publish uses the same build tag and does not allow per-arch retries to push before manifest assembly completes. we'll also add a verification step: compare attestation.subject across registry replicas before marking published.

meera: i'm going to file INF-3221 for cross-replica attestation parity; attaching runner traces. will also change retry behavior to fail fast if cosign produces a different buildid.

deploybot: hold persists. next steps: pin traffic (done once PR merges), republish in 02:30 UTC window using coordinated CI run on runner-pool v2, request canary after publish, and close thread once deploybot reports canary green.

hannah: thanks team. no manual retags on the broken manifests; create a fresh tag for the rebuild and mention the pinned digest in release notes. marking resolved after canary passes or fallback is confirmed live. :white_check_mark:
